text: ___ is the technique of encoding formulas and proofs as natural numbers, which turns provability itself into an arithmetic predicate so that arithmetic can talk about its own syntax.
explanation: Gödel numbering assigns a unique natural number ⌜φ⌝ to each formula or proof (classically via prime factorization), so that 'the formula with number n is provable' becomes an arithmetic statement Provable(n). This self-reference machinery underlies both incompleteness theorems. The expected phrase is 'Gödel numbering'.
